barrier_free_no_barriers.note: T3-S3 main theorem: superstep_free e = true → barrier_free e = true → eval produces no EvBarrier events; EWarpPoint may emit EvWarp (intentional)

cdcf_check_agreement.note: is_varying cond = false (from cdcf=false) → not_varying_converged_clean clears cond; then IH on body

check_env_ESeq.note: F-04b: check_env m env (ESeq es) = check_env_seq m env es; definitional equality exposed as a lemma for rewriting

check_env_diverged_no_barriers_ss.note: T3-S6: resolves the T3-S3 superstep_free side condition over core_frag_ss — Diverged-clean core_frag_ss expressions are barrier-silent

check_env_nonvarying_uniform_args.note: Corollary group bridging the non-varying condition uniformity into the sequence/application inner loops used by eval_check_uniform

check_env_nonvarying_uniform_seq.note: Corollary group bridging the non-varying condition uniformity into the sequence/application inner loops used by eval_check_uniform

check_env_seq_cons.note: F-04b: check_env_seq m env (e :: rest) = check_env m env e ++ check_env_seq (if has_varying_return env e then Diverged else m) env rest; proof by reflexivity

check_env_seq_core_frag.note: F-04b soundness bridge: on core_frag elements the flag never fires, so check_env_seq collapses to the flat-map; recovers the pre-F-04b clean hypothesis in eval_check_uniform Part A ESeq.

check_env_seq_core_frag_ss.note: F-04b ss soundness bridge used by eval_check_uniform_ss Part A ESeq.

check_env_seq_diverged.note: F-04b: check_env_seq Diverged env es = concat (map (check_env Diverged env) es); in Diverged mode the flag-threading collapses to plain flat-map, preserving existing Diverged-mode proofs

check_env_seq_nil.note: F-04b: check_env_seq m env [] = []; proof by reflexivity

check_env_sound_core.note: T3-S4 main theorem: core_frag e = true → check_env Converged env e = [] → barrier_safe vary_val env e; one-liner via proj1 (eval_check_uniform vary_val fuel)

check_env_sound_superstep.note: T3-S6 main theorem: core_frag_ss e = true → check_env Converged env e = [] → barrier_safe vary_val env e; enlarges T3-S4 fragment to include dv=false supersteps

check_seq_hom.note: trivial: simpl unfolds ESeq to concat(map), then map_app + concat_app closes by reflexivity

check_warp_env_diverged_clean_warp_free.note: T3-S7 bridge lemma: check_warp_env Diverged env e = [] → warp_free e = true; ESuperstep does not flag in check_warp_env (no warp hazard at boundary)

check_warp_env_diverged_no_warps.note: T3-S7: core_frag e = true → check_warp_env Diverged env e = [] → eval emits no EvWarp events; dual of check_env_diverged_no_barriers

check_warp_sound_core.note: T3-S7 main theorem: core_frag e = true → check_warp_env Converged env e = [] → warp_safe vary_val env e; warp dual of check_env_sound_core; warp-size parameterization CLOSED (warp_of abstract Section Variable)

closed_uniform.note: T3-S2 corollary: is_var_free e = true → is_varying e = false → eval uniform across all thread ids and variable environments

core_frag_impl_ss.note: T3-S6: core_frag e = true → core_frag_ss e = true — the enlarged fragment subsumes the core

core_frag_no_reachable_return.note: F-04b bridge: core_frag excludes EReturn, so the reachable-return flag never fires on the verified fragment.

core_frag_no_varying_return.note: F-04b bridge: core_frag excludes EReturn, so the varying-return flag never fires on the verified fragment.

core_frag_ss_barrier_free_superstep_free.note: T3-S6: core_frag_ss e = true → barrier_free e = true → superstep_free e = true; a barrier-free core_frag_ss expression has no superstep at all

core_frag_ss_no_reachable_return.note: F-04b ss analogue: core_frag_ss also excludes EReturn (ESuperstep is ignored by has_reachable_return's structural recursion).

core_frag_ss_no_ret.note: T3-S6: no core_frag_ss expression returns ORet; superstep body cannot return and cont is ORet-free by induction

diverged_clean_iff_barrier_free.note: key: diverged_absorbing — (if X then D else D) = D — makes Diverged mode absorbing; proof by expr_list_rect with Plist for ESeq/EApp

diverged_clean_no_barriers.note: T3-S3 corollary: superstep_free e = true → check Diverged e = [] → eval emits no EvBarrier events; follows via diverged_clean_iff_barrier_free

env_check_let_alias_catches.note: F-02 soundness: varying-aliased EVar as CF condition produces BarrierError under Converged mode; proof uses env_lookup_extend_same + app_eq_nil + discriminate

env_let_alias_varying.note: F-02 core: if v is varying in env then ELet x v b propagates variability; proof by simpl + rewrite Hv + exact Hb

env_lookup_extend_same.note: F-02 helper: env_lookup after env_extend with same key returns the stored value; proof by unfold + Nat.eqb_refl + reflexivity

env_var_diverged_clean.note: F-02: EVar under Diverged mode is barrier-free (EVar carries no barrier); proof by simpl + reflexivity

eval_check_uniform.note: T3-S4 combined lemma: simultaneous fuel induction establishing Part A (barrier-trace equality) and Part B (outcome equality for non-varying expressions); Part B feeds back into Part A for condition-uniformity in EIf/EWhile/EFor

eval_check_uniform_ss.note: T3-S6: combined Part A (barrier-trace) + Part B (outcome) uniformity by fuel induction over core_frag_ss; new ESuperstep case emits implicit [EvBarrier] uniformly on all threads

eval_check_warp_uniform.note: T3-S7: warp dual of eval_check_uniform — Part A (erase_barrier trace equality) + Part B (outcome equality) over core_frag with check_warp_env Converged clean; mechanical EBarrier↔EWarpPoint substitution of eval_check_uniform

eval_concrete_barrier_free_silent.note: T3-S8: barrier-silence for eval_concrete; superstep_free ∧ barrier_free → no EvBarrier in trace; mirrored by QCheck sem:barrier_free_silent

eval_concrete_fuel_monotone.note: T3-S8: fuel-monotonicity specialized to eval_concrete; direct application of section theorem eval_fuel_monotone; mirrored by QCheck sem:eval_fuel_monotone

eval_while_exits_immediately_ss.note: T3-S6: core_frag_ss analogue of eval_while_exits_immediately — a terminating core_frag_ss EWhile exits immediately (cond evaluated to 0)

hazard_checker_sound.note: T3-S5 / F-04b: spec/operational agreement — check_env flags the hazard AND it is genuinely not barrier_safe; closes the F-04 spec/impl divergence

hazard_eval_thread0.note: T3-S5: thread 0 evaluates hazard to (ORet 0, []) — early return, no barrier event; proof by reflexivity

hazard_eval_thread1.note: T3-S5: thread 1 evaluates hazard to (ONorm 0, [EvBarrier]) — falls through to barrier; proof by reflexivity

hazard_not_barrier_safe.note: T3-S5 main theorem: ¬ barrier_safe hazard_vary [] hazard — constructive counterexample; erase_warp traces [] vs [EvBarrier] differ across threads

hazard_spec_detects.note: T3-S5 / F-04b: after the F-04b fix, check_env Converged [] hazard ≠ [] — the spec now detects the hazard (supersedes pre-F-04b hazard_checker_blind)

is_strongly_uniform_env_irrelevant.note: T3-S2: alias of var_free_env_irrelevant; is_var_free e = true → is_strongly_uniform env1 e = is_strongly_uniform env2 e

is_strongly_uniform_impl_is_not_varying.note: T3-S2 bridge: is_strongly_uniform env e = true → is_varying_in_env env e = false — strictly stronger predicate

mode_monotone.note: EIf/EWhile/EFor case-split on is_varying cond; varying → inner stays Diverged in both (incl_refl); non-varying → apply IH for inner exprs

not_varying_converged_clean.note: helper for cdcf_check_agreement: is_varying e = false → all inner modes stay Converged → EBarrier gives []

not_varying_uniform.note: T3-S2 main theorem: env_agrees env rho1 rho2 → is_strongly_uniform env e = true → eval vary_val fuel t1 rho1 e = eval vary_val fuel t2 rho2 e

not_varying_uniform_args.note: T3-S2 list variant of not_varying_uniform — mutual induction companion for EApp/ESeq

return_barrier_skip_safe.note: T2-RETURN compositionality: forall m e, check m (EReturn e) = check m e — EReturn is a transparent wrapper for barrier analysis; proof by simpl + reflexivity. Corollary return_converged_clean: barrier_free e → check Converged (EReturn e) = []

semantic_f01_corollary.note: T3-S6: conjunction — susp_hazard is flagged AND not barrier_safe; the F-01 BarrierError is a SOUND rejection grounding superstep_outer_diverged_error at runtime

semantic_f01_flagged.note: T3-S6: check_env Converged [] susp_hazard ≠ [] — the env-threaded checker flags susp_hazard

semantic_f01_not_barrier_safe.note: T3-S6: ¬ barrier_safe susp_vary [] susp_hazard — barrier traces [EvBarrier; EvBarrier] vs [] diverge across env-agreeing threads

superstep_outer_diverged_error.note: F-01: Diverged entry into ESuperstep with divergent=false yields BarrierError; proof by simpl + discriminate

susp_eval_thread0.note: T3-S6: thread 0 evaluates susp_hazard to (ONorm 0, [EvBarrier; EvBarrier]); proof by reflexivity

susp_eval_thread1.note: T3-S6: thread 1 evaluates susp_hazard to (ONorm 0, []); proof by reflexivity

var_free_env_irrelevant.note: T3-S2: is_var_free e = true → is_strongly_uniform env1 e = is_strongly_uniform env2 e (EVar-free means env-independent)

var_free_is_strongly_uniform_empty.note: T3-S2: is_var_free e = true → is_varying e = false → is_strongly_uniform [] e = true

varying_if_flags_barriers.note: is_varying cond → inner=Diverged; then diverged_clean_iff_barrier_free: ¬barrier_free → check Diverged ≠ [] → contradiction

warp_diverged_error.note: T2-WARP atomic: check_warp Diverged EWarpPoint ≠ []; models Warp_collective_in_diverged_flow from Sarek_convergence.ml lines 153-155; proof by simpl + discriminate

warp_free_no_warps.note: T3-S7 trace-silence theorem: superstep_free e = true → warp_free e = true → eval emits no EvWarp events; dual of barrier_free_no_barriers

warp_mode_monotone.note: T2-WARP quantified: forall e, incl (check_warp Converged e) (check_warp Diverged e) — warp analogue of mode_monotone; proven by expr_list_rect + diverged_absorbing

warp_varying_if_flags.note: T2-WARP context: forall el, check_warp Converged (EIf EVary EWarpPoint el) ≠ [] — EWarpPoint nested under varying EIf is always caught; proof by simpl + discriminate
